title: The guard joins an absolute project.worktrees onto the…
what: plugins/relay/hooks/guard_main.py:231: LOW: F4 the guard joins an absolute project.worktrees onto the main checkout (main + "/" + "/Users/x/wt")
why: 29 Oct, review of the lane-start worktree-folder fix, outside that change: an absolute project.worktrees setting is joined onto the main checkout by the guard. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: kit.toml worktrees = "/Users/x/wt": Guard.wtdir = "/Users/x/wt"; wtroot compares paths against "<main>//Users/x/wt", which never matches, and the advice prints "git worktree add /Users/x/wt/<name>" (right) while the extra-folder check is dead.
Expected: the extra folder is /Users/x/wt itself.
pass_cases: 1. worktrees = "/abs/wts": a write to /abs/wts/a/f.py is inside a task worktree (also true today through git's worktree list when a is registered).
2. worktrees = ".worktrees": a write to <main>/.worktrees/a/f.py is inside a task worktree (unchanged).

fact: Reproduced by code read 30 Oct 2026 on master: plugins/relay/hooks/guard_main.py:232 keeps an absolute worktrees value as wtdir; line 272 builds main + "/" + wtdir ("<main>//Users/x/wt"), so the extra-folder check at 273-274 never matches; the advice at 255-256 is right. No live kit.toml sets an absolute worktrees value today.
